Method of Attack: Spyware deployed in mass-surveillance targeting Iranian citizens
Steals clipboard contents, device location, SMS messages, contact list, call logs, records calls, content of notifications, installed and running apps, device info
Distributed via fake websites cloning real ones, delivered through direct messages, social media posts, emails, SMS, black SEO, and SEO poisoning
Receives commands from command and control (C2) server via HTTP requests
Obfuscation of class names, strings, logs, and server URI paths to evade detection
Attack Vector: Fake websites mimicking legitimate services (e.g., English-to-Persian translation service)
APK file download via fake Google Play button
Social engineering via direct messages, social media, emails, SMS, SEO poisoning
Indicators of Compromise: Fake website URLs (not explicitly listed but implied)
HTTP requests to C2 server every 10 seconds
Date of Discovery: Recent version analyzed by ESET (date not explicitly stated)
